Hi Alex / David — looping in some detail from our security team on the items you asked about. Happy to jump on the Nov 10 call.

Vulnerability management (summary):
- Internal scanning cadence: automated SAST/DAST + dependency scans run weekly with triage workflows in Jira.
- External scanning: authenticated external scans on a quarterly cadence; ad-hoc scans after major infra or product changes.
- Third-party pen tests: annual, plus before major releases or upon customer request. We engage reputable firms and rotate vendors periodically.

SLA & remediation windows (customer-facing guidance):
- Critical (CVSS 9.0-10.0): initial mitigation/temporary control within 72 hours; permanent remediation targeted within 14–30 days depending on complexity.
- High (CVSS 7.0-8.9): initial mitigation within 7 days; remediation targeted within 30–60 days.
- Medium/Low: prioritized based on impact and roadmap.

Disclosure / coordinated reporting:
- We follow a coordinated disclosure policy: customer-impacting issues are communicated via our security contact channel; we will not publicly disclose issues affecting customers without prior notice and coordination. For severe incidents we provide notification timelines in the BAA/SLA.

Evidence & questionnaire turnaround:
- We can populate the vendor security questionnaire with initial responses in ~3–5 business days; evidence (e.g., config screenshots, log retention policies, control owners) provided via secure portal after NDA.

Contacts & next steps:
- I'll join the Nov 10 call with Marissa and our contracts lead. For follow-ups, please send any specific questions in the questionnaire that need technical detail.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
